the model says the meaning changed: The stop hook now skips the reminder to ask waiting judge questions whenever ask_gate.applies is false (unattended or subagent sessions), so those questions are no longer pushed to be asked "as soon as it arises", which weakens the requirement that every blocking gap is asked through the question tool.; brought to the owner as a card: The requirement and your intent still agree: every question that changes what gets built should be asked right away, through the question tool, and never dropped.

The change is in the check that runs when the agent finishes a turn. Before, that check always reminded the agent to ask any judge questions still waiting. Now it skips the reminder in sessions that have no question tool, which are sessions running with nobody watching and helper agents working under a main one. The questions are not deleted. They just aren't brought up in a session that has no way to ask them.

This looks like a sensible fix, since telling a session to use a tool it doesn't have does nothing useful. But the requirement doesn't say what should happen to waiting questions in such a session, and none of its examples cover that case. The last message logged before the change was about a different topic (which hosts to keep in a merge), so it doesn't show whether you wanted this. You need to decide whether waiting questions can be held until a session that can ask them, or whether they must still be pushed somewhere right away.; the card is not offered until it is complete, it lacks: what option 1 ("Keep the change and add to the requirement that questions wait for a session with a question tool, since one without it can't ask them") does and leaves undone; what option 2 ("Keep the change, but make the main session ask the questions its helper agents would have raised") does and leaves undone; what option 3 ("Undo the change so every session is always reminded of waiting questions") does and leaves undone; why the recommended option is recommended (iaso stale card SR-223#3 --consequences "..." --why "...")
